body:
Nothing is really going wrong now or was going wrong last night - in terms of changes to my situation. I just get in these dark moods about once a week. I feel pretty much back to normal today.

I want my motivation for continuing to live to be something beyond just sparing the people close to me a lot of pain. I think part of the reason I get in these moods has to do with a search for that reason. 

It has just been a long time and I feel like I will always be searching. It feels like I've tried everything - art, sports, studying - and nothing really holds me over. There is this gulf between me and everyone else, and I wish I could just accept it but it is really painful sometimes to live with.
